ResearchTabDef.label: Delta-V
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research sealed docking systems, ship weapons, shields and nuclear power. Basic cargo, EVA and support equipment use technologies on the main research tab. Research unlocks construction and manufacture; recovered equipment can already be used.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vacuum barrier
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build sealed docking ports and moon pool decks. Docking ports provide air-tight access between ships. Moon pools hold atmosphere behind a transparent force field while allowing shuttles to launch and land.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ship artillery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build small and medium heavy cannons and rapid cannons, missile launchers and their ammunition magazines. Manufacture ship propellant, high-explosive and armor-piercing projectile heads, and high-explosive guided missiles at a machining table.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ship lasers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build small and medium laser cannons, point-defense lasers and auxiliary laser capacitors. The same beam technology also enables ship-mounted mining beams for cutting structures and recovering minerals.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ship shields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build small and standard ship shield generators. Each generator can switch between a guard shield, a kinetic barrier that redirects physical projectiles, and an electromagnetic barrier that refracts laser beams.

ResearchProjectDef.label: electromagnetic railguns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build small and large railgun loading units, matching accelerator segments and capacitors. These weapons consume powerful electrical pulses to penetrate ship defenses and internal compartments. With fabrication technology, energy recovery modules can reduce accelerator power consumption.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shipboard nuclear power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build compact uranium-fueled fission reactors to supply sustained power for shipboard life support, industry and weapons.
